import 'dart:async';

Future<void> inOrder<E>(Iterable<E> values, Future<void> Function(E) apply, {required String reason}) async {
  for (final value in values) {
    await apply(value);
  }
}

Future<void> use() async {
  await inOrder<Object>([], (value) async {}, reason: 'Each update reads the previous write');
  await Runner().inOrder<Object>(values: [], apply: (value) async {}, reason: 'Each update reads the previous write');
}

class Runner {
  Future<void> inOrder<E>({required String reason, required Iterable<E> values, required FutureOr<void> Function(E) apply}) async {
    for (final value in values) {
      await apply(value);
    }
  }
}
